items.h: How Crypto Stopped Waiting for Congress and Learned to Love the Regulators
items.s: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves. Will it be enough?

items.h: Kalshi loses appeal over Ohio and Tennessee sports betting laws, widening circuit split

items.h: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
items.s: An open competition run by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs drove the estimated cost of building a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction from about $320 to roughly $67, with AI models topping the leaderboards.
